invocation_gate: Evaluate a real counterpart only after an authentic acceptance event exists. This schema defines evidence classes and does not authorize proactive customer/contact/agreement lookup.

canonical_contract_state.boundary: Defines canonical business state; does not itself prove a customer's authority.

contract_operations.boundary: Operational evidence owner; repository approval/draft is not execution.

contact_directory.boundary: Corroborative identity/role evidence only; no observed delegation/signature-authority field.

customer_authorization.boundary: May verify authority only when authenticity, organization attribution, scope, validity and non-revocation are established.

prior_executed_agreement.boundary: May support authority only when the agreement is authentic, applicable to the current organization/role/scope and not expired/superseded/revoked.

examples: board/member/officer resolution or written consent identifying signatory authority
organization-controlled signatory/authority registry with attributable provenance
requirements: named counterpart or deterministically resolved role

examples: authentic prior executed agreement identifying the same counterpart as authorized signatory
existing master agreement/delegation defining authorized role
requirements: same legal customer entity or explicit applicable successor
authority language applicable to current proposal

evidence_hierarchy.boundary: Can corroborate identity/role and resolve a role named by Level 1/2 evidence; role/title alone does not grant contracting authority.
Locally stored or directory contact metadata is not delegation evidence.

requires: at least one Level 1 evidence item, or Level 2 evidence item whose authority language is applicable
scope and temporal validity cover exact proposal acceptance
VERIFIED.effect: Satisfies VERIFIED_COUNTERPART_AUTHORITY evidence predicate only; does not establish legal enforceability, signature sufficiency, contract execution, payment or CRM authority.

when: Level 1/2 evidence authenticity, attribution, scope, temporal validity or non-revocation is incomplete
conflicting evidence exists without authoritative resolution
no authority evidence has been queried because no authentic acceptance event exists

requires: authentic organization-attributable evidence affirmatively shows the counterpart lacks required authority, or authority was revoked/expired/superseded before acceptance
or verified authority scope expressly excludes the proposed engagement
REJECTED.effect: Counterpart-authority predicate fails for that acceptance observation; does not make any broader legal conclusion.
